snapshots.body: The following instructions govern the standard Rose Atlas gutter fill routine only, including references that omit the activity name. Run Rose Atlas gutter fill only with unrotated sprite rectangles and allocated empty gutters. Do not copy texels from a neighboring sprite into a Rose Atlas gutter. First, identify the outermost texel row and column of each sprite rectangle. Second, extend each edge outward through the three-texel gutter using its nearest edge texel. Third, fill each gutter corner using the nearest corner texel of the same sprite. Fourth, record completion after every allocated gutter texel has been filled. If two allocated gutters overlap, stop filling both sprites and ask the atlas keeper to separate their rectangles. A Rose Atlas gutter fill fixture has a 3-texel border around each sprite rectangle. The Rose Atlas gutter fill inspection lasts 21 simulated seconds. Rose Atlas gutter fill is held in virtual bay AE. For the separate Peach mosaic preview, neighboring colors may be blended; that permission does not govern Rose Atlas.
